summary: Vera Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 on September 15, 2026, disclosing that TRUTAKNA (atacicept-vymj) met all prespecified endpoints in the final efficacy analysis of the ORIGIN 3 trial in adults with primary IgA nephropathy. The 428-patient study showed a 5.6 mL/min/1.73m2 mean eGFR treatment effect at 52 weeks and a 76% reduction in composite kidney disease progression events through 104 weeks, both p=0.0001, with safety comparable to placebo. No deal, board recommendation, advisor or transaction terms are stated; this is a clinical data release, not a special situation.
